scientific_case: WSe2 BiDB row2685, AB to mirror-derived BA path A
original_structure_relaxation: BiDB z-scan frozen monolayers; NOT full ionic relaxation
credential_policy: Use only existing local SSH keys/profiles; never copy passwords/tokens/private keys to git or chat logs.
pseudopotential_policy: Licensed local PBE PAW W then Se; no POTCAR or its contents to GitHub. Record checksum, TITEL and ENMAX only. Verify ENCUT >=1.3x maximal ENMAX.

execution.step0: Checkout exact research branch and record commit SHA. Abort if tree untrusted or previous historical files changed.
execution.step1: Run python3 hpc-stage8g/prepare.py --out <a fresh external workdir>; verify 15 files and only 3 pilot flagged.
execution.step2: Probe WSL and Japan PBS read-only via existing configured access; do not echo credentials. Prefer authorized Japan PBS.
execution.step3: Determine VASP executable/MPI/bootstrap and authorized pseudopotentials ON THE COMPUTE SITE; set separate local profile file validated only after actual checks.
execution.step4: Check three pilot inputs are identical in INCAR/KPOINTS/POTCAR and PBE+D3; all F F T, identical lattice; run onsite_pbs.py --jobs workdir --site local_site.json (dry run).
execution.step5: Submit only flagged 3 pilot jobs with onsite_pbs.py --jobs workdir --site local_site.json --submit; persist IDs; don't duplicate on rerun.
execution.step6: Track PBS job status and gather authentic OUTCAR/CONTCAR. Audit inputs vs outputs, ionic/electronic convergence, last forces, fixed lateral coordinates, cell, comparison settings, and actual final symmetry.
execution.step7: Return a concise Chinese report with job IDs, remote output paths, energies if actually complete, status and blockers. Do not infer NEB barrier or static NMEE.

stop_conditions: Pilot scientific inputs differ or hashes change
ENCUT cannot meet 1.3 ENMAX without explicit convergence adjustment
Existing nonempty or inconsistent remote directory
Prior job ID exists but scheduler state unknown
Charge/allocations not authorized by local access policy
forbidden_actions: Invent queue names, credentials, DFT output or results
Upload POTCAR, private keys, SSH config, raw large outputs or private job data to public GitHub
Treat WSL itself as a proven supercomputer queue
Treat stage8f z-only energies as an NEB barrier
Claim source row2685 is fully relaxed
Claim actual WSe2 NMEE or driven DC calculated

result_contract.final_TOTEN_eV_by_name: numbers only from actual converged VASP outputs; otherwise null
